🚨 PLEASE SHARE!!! 🚨

Today is the official launch of @blackresiliency application for the 3-year basic income cohort!! 

If you are 18+, identify as Black, and live in Multnomah County, you’re encouraged to apply. Applications are open until August 15th. 

#BlackLivesMatter ✊🏾 https://t.co/7byYpSiNhX

Thanks to my friends who supported @blackresiliency this week!

Since Monday we’ve received over 8,000 applications for our 3-year basic income cohort!!

We’re over halfway towards our goal with our $100k matching campaign!!! 

Donate at https://t.co/ojIbDpkCPD

#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/QpTaHRFPAr

Thank you @wweek for this write up on @blackresiliency new income guarantee program! We are still accepting applications until August 15. 

And we need your support! Donate today at https://t.co/ojIbDpkCPD.

#blacklivesmatter #buildingblack
